review.description: All 657 term definitions, stable IDs and aliases retain their meanings; only operational verification instructions and shared runner execution are extended. No consumer backlinks enter glossary ownership.
review.implementation: Compared terms.json and foundation dependency ownership with main. The optional executor leaves ordinary reconciliation callbacks, fixture mode, fingerprints and registry generation unchanged; local session identity adds no glossary meaning.
review.tests: Inspected RegistryTests.test_dependency_direction and unchanged term definition checks, plus the new actual-subprocess and source/helper invalidation assertions. Required tooling and all currently declared consumer suites execute fresh for this comparison.
